about: The provider catalogue's overlay as the dashboard's form writes it (frontend/src/lib/catalogueOverlay.ts overlayYaml, its test beside this file): each case's yaml is what the form writes for its overlay, and what the catalogue reads back to the same overlay (tests/unit/agents/test_catalogue_overlay_yaml.py). Both sides read this file, so neither can drift from the other. A case with "valid": false is no catalogue (its id routes to no provider): the backend reads it back but does not merge it. The form decides by a field's name how to write it: "whole_number_keys" as integers (WHOLE_NUMBER_KEYS; every other number as a float), "date_keys" as bare days (DATE_KEYS; any other string quoted), "json_keys" as JSON, their numbers as they are (EXTRAS_KEYS). The backend checks each list against the overlay's schema and the frontend against the writer, so a field the schema gains cannot be written as the wrong type.

cases.name: a provider on, a shipped model re-priced
cases.yaml:
providers:
  deepseek:
    enabled: true
    models:
      deepseek-flash:
        prices:
          - {in: 0.15, out: 0.6}

cases.name: a custom model, free and chat-only, its id quoted
cases.yaml:
providers:
  custom:
    enabled: true
    models:
      "custom/qwen3:32b":
        free: true
        chat_only: true

cases.name: a model added with whole-dollar and dated prices
cases.yaml:
providers:
  openai:
    enabled: true
    models:
      gpt-new:
        prices:
          - {in: 1.0, out: 2.0}
          - {from: 2026-12-01, in: 2.0, out: 4.0}

cases.name: request extras, nested
cases.yaml:
providers:
  custom:
    models:
      custom/local:
        free: true
        request_extras: {"chat_template_kwargs":{"enable_thinking":false},"temperature":0.2}

cases.name: a custom model's context window, a whole number
cases.yaml:
providers:
  custom:
    enabled: true
    models:
      "custom/qwen3:32b":
        free: true
        context_window: 32768

cases.name: background request extras, their numbers as written
cases.yaml:
providers:
  custom:
    models:
      custom/local:
        free: true
        background_request_extras: {"chat_template_kwargs":{"enable_thinking":false},"max_tokens":600}

cases.name: the version, factors and a default price
cases.yaml:
version: 1
providers:
  custom:
    factors:
      turns: 2.0
    default_price:
      in: 0.0
      out: 0.0

cases.name: a tiny and a huge price, in plain decimals
cases.yaml:
providers:
  openai:
    enabled: true
    models:
      gpt-edge:
        prices:
          - {in: 0.0000001, out: 1000000000000000000000.0}

cases.name: model ids YAML 1.1 would read as a bool, a null or a number, quoted
cases.yaml:
providers:
  deepseek:
    models:
      "on":
        free: true
      "No":
        free: true
      "null":
        free: true
      "~":
        free: true
      "1.5":
        free: true
